breaking_news_suggestions.headline: Pre-registered dome model falsified by 223x on the Aug 12 eclipse
breaking_news_suggestions.summary: Dome's own frozen geometry forced a 1.317 km umbral shadow lasting at most 7 seconds. Five independent sources — satellites, ground observers across two countries, and a professional observatory — recorded a shadow 290 km wide lasting up to 138 seconds. Locked in writing and cryptographically timestamped three months before the event.
